referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the transformation from medium to low voltage as well as the distribution of electricity at low voltage.; UUID: 109ddd62-142d-3dcd-928c-46038ed44171
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the electricity production in Abbreviation, the transmission network as well as direct SF6-emissions to air. Electricity losses during low-voltage transmission and transformation from medium-voltage are accounted for.

geography.text: Data apply to public and self producers. Geographical classification according to IEA. Assumptions for transmission network, losses and emissions are based on Swiss data.

technology.text: Average technology used to distribute electricity. Includes underground and overhead lines, as well as air- and SF6-insulated medium-to-low voltage switching stations. Electricity production according to related datasets
